stable_traits.personality: thoughtful, cautious, carries guilt about his origins, protective of Mat, homesick

characters.notes: Primary POV character for this chapter. The text shows his internal struggle with identity and homesickness.

stable_traits.personality: increasingly suspicious, paranoid, protective of the ruby dagger, performs juggling tricks

characters.notes: Shows increasing paranoia and obsessive connection to the Shadar Logoth dagger. His personality is deteriorating.
Does not appear in person; Rand watches for him on the road and uses his instruments. Presumed dead or lost after Whitebridge.

stable_traits.filiations: father of Rand (adoptive, though Rand doesn't yet fully accept this)

aliases_observed.notes: How Rand thinks of him, though he's struggling with the relationship

characters.notes: Only appears in Rand's thoughts and memories, particularly regarding the sword Tam gave him.

stable_traits.filiations: husband of Mistress Grinwell, father of nine children including Else

characters.notes: A farmer who hires Rand and Mat for work and offers them hospitality.

stable_traits.filiations: wife of Master Grinwell, mother of nine children including Else
stable_traits.personality: protective of her daughter, watchful, reminds Rand of Mistress al'Vere

characters.notes: Watches Rand carefully when she suspects her daughter Else is interested in him. Diplomatically arranges for them to leave.

stable_traits.age: not more than a year younger than Rand and Mat
stable_traits.filiations: daughter of Master and Mistress Grinwell, eldest of nine children

characters.notes: Shows romantic interest in Rand, which causes tension with her mother.
A farmer who gives Rand and Mat a ride in his cart after drinking too much at the inn.
Only appears in Rand's thoughts when he wishes Perrin were there to help handle Else's flirtation.

appearances.whereabouts: Traveling the Caemlyn Road from Whitebridge eastward toward Caemlyn, passing through various villages and farms
appearances.notable_actions: Watches for pursuers on the road; hides from passing riders; works on farms for food and shelter; plays Thom's flute at inns and farms; develops a traveling performer routine with Mat; struggles with homesickness and questions about his identity; at Grinwell's farm plays multiple songs to avoid Mistress Grinwell's scrutiny
appearances.demeanor: Homesick, melancholy, cautious, increasingly practical about survival, uncomfortable with Else's attention, haunted by questions about his origins

appearances.whereabouts: Traveling the Caemlyn Road with Rand from Whitebridge toward Caemlyn
appearances.notable_actions: Searches for hiding places in hedgerows; becomes increasingly suspicious of everyone they meet; protects the ruby dagger obsessively; juggles Thom's colored balls for children and inn patrons; attempts to steal eggs and milk a cow (unsuccessfully); teases Rand about Else
appearances.demeanor: Increasingly paranoid and suspicious, mutters in his sleep, tense around strangers, relaxes slightly around children, obsessive about the dagger

appearances.whereabouts: Absent; last seen at Whitebridge, fate unknown
appearances.notable_actions: None in this chapter; Rand watches for him on the road but never sees him

appearances.whereabouts: Not present; back in the Two Rivers
appearances.notable_actions: None; exists only in Rand's memories and thoughts about the sword

appearances.whereabouts: His farm along the Caemlyn Road
appearances.notable_actions: Hires Rand and Mat to work in his barn; provides them with a meal and lodging; enjoys their evening entertainment; suggests they could stay longer

appearances.whereabouts: Her farm along the Caemlyn Road
appearances.notable_actions: Washes Rand and Mat's clothes; provides them with her husband's old clothes; watches Rand carefully when Else shows interest; arranges for them to sleep in Else's room (with Else sleeping elsewhere); suggests they leave early the next morning; gives advice about the next village
appearances.demeanor: Initially kind and motherly, becomes watchful and protective of her daughter, sharp-eyed, diplomatically firm about their departure

appearances.whereabouts: Grinwell farm along the Caemlyn Road
appearances.notable_actions: Watches Rand and Mat work in the barn; chews her pigtail; tells Rand she likes tall men; sits cross-legged by the fire during the evening entertainment; sighs and smiles at Rand's flute playing; grimaces when told she'll sleep with her mother; pouts when Rand leaves
appearances.demeanor: Flirtatious, impudent, romantic, disappointed when thwarted

appearances.whereabouts: At an inn in Arien, then traveling east on the road
appearances.notable_actions: Drinks too much at the inn; gives Rand and Mat a ride five miles east in his cart

appearances.whereabouts: Not present; separated from Rand and Mat (location unknown to Rand)
appearances.notable_actions: None; exists only in Rand's thoughts

relationships.description: Traveling companions fleeing toward Caemlyn together, working together to survive
Thom was Rand's teacher in music; Rand carries his instruments and treasures his memory
Father and son (though Rand is struggling with the revelation that he's adopted); Tam gave Rand the heron-marked sword
Husband and wife, parents of nine children
Mother and daughter; mother is protective when daughter shows interest in Rand
Else shows romantic interest in Rand, flirting with him and complimenting his music
